subject: Acme - Invoice estimate & cost model follow-up
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Ben Meyers <ben.m@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Acme - Invoice estimate & cost model follow-up

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and I’m attaching a first-pass cost model and one-page estimate: acme_cost_model_v1.xlsx, pricing_calc_1M_tokens.pdf, redwood_estimate_acme_20260710.pdf.

Key takeaways I recorded:
- Workload: interactive chat + summary generation for customer support (average response length ~120 tokens).
- Expected qps: peaks ~8-12 r/s, average sustained ~4 r/s.
- Target latency: p95 < 300ms for 1k token contexts.
- Data controls: needs VPC/private deployment option for PII redaction; will evaluate Dedicated.

Pricing/volume questions we need to lock down to finalize the invoice estimate:
1) Monthly active users and estimated average messages per MAU (so we can convert to monthly tokens).
2) Average token count per request and per response (we used 120 tokens/response in the model).
3) Target unit economics: you mentioned wanting to keep infra spend ~ $X / 1M tokens — can you share a target $/1M tokens or a monthly budget range?

Attached the spreadsheet with tabs: assumptions, token_breakdown, instance_mix, and invoice_summary. The pricing_calc_1M_tokens.pdf shows the unit math we used (example: $3,500 / 1M tokens for a 16-bit quantized hosted variant; Dedicated varies by committed hours).

Next steps I propose:
- You share back the MAU and average message counts (or we can map usage by support ticket volume).
- We iterate the spreadsheet and I’ll produce a formal invoice estimate and a one-page summary for procurement.
- If useful, Marissa can run a quick Dedicated sizing session (30m) to show throughput/cost tradeoffs.

If you want a target to react to now, we modeled three tiers: Starter (up to 50M tokens/mo), Growth (50–500M tokens/mo), Scale (500M+ tokens/mo) with suggested target $/1M tokens around $3.0–$4.5 depending on Dedicated commit and batching.

Thanks — I’ll hold off on a formal invoice until we confirm volumes and your preferred deployment mode.

Best,
Sean
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
redwood.com
From: Ben Meyers <ben.m@acme.com>

Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme - Invoice estimate & cost model follow-up

Sean —

Appreciate the summary and the files. Quick answers:
- MAU: right now ~12k, but the pilot will be scoped to ~2k MAU for 3 months.
- Avg messages per MAU: we estimate 6 messages per MAU per month for the pilot; long-term could be 20/month.
- Token counts: typical user turn is ~60 tokens user -> ~140 tokens model response (we'll confirm).
- Budget: for the pilot team we have ~$8k/month ceiling. Long-term budget TBD but we want unit economics under ~$5 / 1M tokens ideally.

Can you run the pilot numbers against the $8k/mo constraint and send a recommended configuration? Also please flag any minimum committed spend for Dedicated that would be relevant.

Ben
Ben Meyers
Product Lead, Acme Corp
ben.m@acme.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Ben Meyers <ben.m@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:28:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme - Invoice estimate & cost model follow-up

Thanks Ben — that helps a lot. I updated the attached spreadsheet (acme_cost_model_v1.xlsx) with a pilot tab reflecting 2k MAU x 6 messages = 12k requests/mo. Using your token numbers (60 in / 140 out) gives ~2.4M tokens/mo for the pilot.

Pilot cost options we modeled (all hosted, no Dedicated commit):
- Option A (conservative): Standard hosted model (16-bit) with modest batching: ~ $3,800 / month => unit ~$1,583 / 1M tokens (note: this reflects no committed Dedicated discounts, includes streaming costs).
- Option B (optimized): Higher-batch settings + KV prefix caching for repeated prompts: ~ $2,700 / month => unit ~$1,125 / 1M tokens.
- Option C (mini Dedicated reserve): 1-month reserved node for pilot (4 GPUs shared) + lower per-token execution cost: ~$1,450 / month => unit ~$604 / 1M tokens but requires a minimum 1-month reserved commitment (we outlined the invoice estimate in redwood_estimate_acme_20260710.pdf).

Given your $8k/month pilot ceiling, all three options fit comfortably. If your goal is <$5 / 1M tokens long-term, that's trivially achievable — I think you meant $5 / 1M tokens (you wrote $5 earlier) but just confirming since our model shows $/1M tokens far lower for these pilot scales — please confirm the target.

Notes on assumptions and next steps:
- The Cost Model tab breaks down: model inference cost, instance amortization, network egress, and support.
- Dedicated minimums: Dedicated plans have monthly reserved minimums that vary by region; the mini Dedicated example above is illustrative and would require a short contract (1–3 months) to secure the lower unit pricing. Marissa can provide exact committed numbers based on region and instance mix.

Marissa — can you prep a 30m sizing run for Monday to show Dedicated vs hosted pilot numbers (I put a draft agenda in the sheet)?

Ben — if ok, I’ll send a short formal invoice estimate for Option B and C (hosted optimized + mini Dedicated) so procurement has a line-item PDF.

Best,
Sean
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

- Region preference (us-west vs us-east) — affects instance pricing and egress.
- Any expected spikes that would require autoscale headroom?

I’ll bring the Dedicated minimums table and a quick invoice draft. I’ve also attached a one-page invoice summary and the pricing calculator PDF for easy review.

Marissa
